facts.statement: Qiliania was an enantiornithean bird that lived in what is now Gansu Province in north-western China.
facts.quote: It is an enantiornithean which lived in what is now Gansu Province, north-western China.

facts.statement: The fossils were found in the Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin.
facts.quote: which were found in the Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin.

facts.statement: Qiliania was first named by a team including Shu-An Ji and Peter Dodson in 2011.
facts.quote: It was first named by Shu-An Ji, Jessie Atterholt, Jingmai O'Connor, Matthew Lamanna, Jerry Harrs, Li Da-Qing, You Hai-Lu and Peter Dodson in 2011

facts.statement: The species name graffini honors Greg Graffin of the band Bad Religion, suggested by co-author Jingmai O'Connor.
facts.quote: The species was named for Greg Graffin, a paleontologist and member of the punk rock group Bad Religion, at the suggestion of coauthor Jingmai O'Connor, a longtime fan of the band.

facts.statement: Qiliania is classified in the class Aves and the subclass Enantiornithes.
facts.quote: regnum: Animalia phylum: Chordata classis: Aves subclassis: Enantiornithes

facts.statement: Qiliania lived during the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Qiliania is an extinct genus of early bird from the lower Cretaceous, approximately 120 million years ago.
rejected.quote: Qiliania (from the Xiongnu qilian, "heaven") is an extinct genus of early bird from the lower Cretaceous (Aptian stage) about 120 million years ago.
